what_this_is: The part registry the DELPHI kernel compiles from. Every number here is quoted from the paper that measured it, with the place in that paper where it is printed. A part with no primary record keeps its slot and is marked open; the kernel refuses to emit a sequence for an open slot rather than substituting something that looks similar.
scope_limit: Transcriptional logic and fluorescent reporters in laboratory Escherichia coli only. This registry deliberately contains no toxin, virulence, host-range, immune-evasion or resistance-transfer part, and the compiler refuses any part identifier that is not in this file.
unit_warning: Kelly 2009 reports RPU against one reference construct and Stanton 2014 reports REU against a different one. They are not the same unit. The kernel's condition check refuses to put a number from one into a law alongside a number from the other; see conditions.reference_standard on each measurement.

stanton2014.citation: Stanton BC, Nielsen AAK, Tamsir A, Clancy K, Peterson T, Voigt CA. Genomic mining of prokaryotic repressors for orthogonal logic gates. Nature Chemical Biology 10:99-105 (2014).
stanton2014.note: Figures and supplementary tables were not read. Every value below is printed in the running text or the Online Methods.

known_defects_in_the_sources.what: The abstract and discussion both say 16 orthogonal gates, but the sentence listing them names 20 repressors (TetR, IcaRA, AmtR, BetI, SrpR, Orf2, BM3R1, ButR, PhlF, AmeR, QacR, LmrA, PsrA, HlyIIR, McbR, ScbR, TarA, LitR, HapR, SmcR).
known_defects_in_the_sources.consequence: The registry does not record a count of orthogonal gates, and the orthogonality law is applied only to the named pairs the paper states crosstalk for.

known_defects_in_the_sources.what: The multi-laboratory sentence prints BBa_J23150 twice: 'BBa_J23150: 0.14-0.23 RPU; BBa_J23150: 0.38-0.61 RPU; BBa_J23103: 0.77-0.96 RPU'. One of those two ranges belongs to another promoter, almost certainly BBa_J23151, but the paper as printed does not say which.
known_defects_in_the_sources.consequence: The 0.38-0.61 RPU range is recorded as unattributable and is not used. J23151 keeps only the separately printed 'approximately 0.5 RPU'.
